description: This file defines a template class StreamJSONType within the WPEFramework::Core namespace, implementing a JSON stream handler with serialization and deserialization capabilities, including nested classes for managing JSON data transmission over a network or inter-process communication.

classes.name: StreamJSONType
classes.description: A template class providing JSON stream handling with nested serializer and deserializer implementations, managing data flow for a specified interface.

classes.name: SerializerImpl
classes.description: Handles serialization of interface data into a stream, managing a queue of outgoing messages with thread safety.

classes.name: DeserializerImpl
classes.description: Handles deserialization of incoming data streams into interface objects, managing current object state and invoking received callbacks.

classes.name: HandlerType
classes.description: A handler class inheriting from SOURCE, facilitating data transmission and reception, and signaling state changes.

methods.name: Link
methods.description: Returns a reference to the linked source object.

methods.name: Received
methods.description: Pure virtual method to handle received interface objects.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Pure virtual method to send interface objects.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Pure virtual method to handle state change notifications.

methods.name: Submit
methods.description: Submits an interface object for transmission if the channel is open.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the communication channel, waiting up to the specified time.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the communication channel, waiting up to the specified time.

methods.name: IsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the channel is open.

methods.name: IsClosed
methods.description: Checks if the channel is closed.

methods.name: IsSuspended
methods.description: Checks if the channel is suspended.

methods.name: IsIdle
methods.description: Checks if both serializer and deserializer are idle.
